projects.title: Meeting Room Reservation System
projects.shortDescription: Full stack web system for meeting room reservations management in corporate environment
projects.problem: Manual paper-based control generated scheduling conflicts, rework, and low employee adoption across two company locations.
projects.solution: Centralized web application with interactive calendar and automatic notifications, completely digitalizing the reservation process.
impact: 150+ active users across 2 locations (headquarters and branch)
projects.infrastructureRole: Docker deployment on Linux server, automated backup, uptime monitoring, and centralized logs.

projects.title: Sales Forecast Pipeline
projects.shortDescription: Automated pipeline with Apache Airflow for sales forecasting using 4 statistical models
projects.problem: Analyst spent almost a week manually generating forecasts and spreadsheets, a repetitive and error-prone process that delayed strategic decisions.
projects.solution: ETL pipeline with Airflow that automates data collection, applies 4 statistical models (Holt, ARIMA, AutoARIMA, Holt-Winters) and generates spreadsheets for manager input.
impact: Reduction from 1 week to 2 hours of processing (97% faster)
4 statistical models running automatically (Holt, ARIMA, AutoARIMA, Holt-Winters)
Monthly forecasts automatically delivered to managers
Elimination of manual errors in ETL process
Gain of 5 days/month in analyst productivity
projects.infrastructureRole: Docker containerization, DAG orchestration, job monitoring, automatic email alerts, and structured logs.

projects.title: DATASUS Data Extraction Automation
projects.shortDescription: Python automation for DATASUS data extraction and analysis for market intelligence
projects.problem: Marketing department needed DATASUS data for competitor analysis and market share, but manual extraction was time-consuming and error-prone.
projects.solution: Python script that automates monthly DATASUS data extraction, filters relevant information, and makes it available in database for market intelligence analysis.
impact: 100% automation of data extraction and filtering
Monthly execution scheduled via Task Scheduler
Sales and competition data available for strategic analysis
Support for Marketing department's market intelligence
Month-2 sales analysis for decision making
projects.infrastructureRole: Task Scheduler scheduling, structured logs, error handling, and automatic email notifications
